title: Shared-backbone DSConv + Even/Odd mean/LSE cw-mix + BiGRU(160), scalar gate — seed=123
abstract: Replication of Even/Odd interleaved pooling (seed=123) to assess stability. Universal design with channel-wise learned soft mix and scalar-gated fusion.
